label: PF Backlog 195
title: Backend: multimodal LLM plumbing (attach image/audio/video parts in llm_client)
body:
## Problem / why
core/orchestrator/llm_client.py builds TEXT prompts only (no image_url/input_audio/content parts), so
the 65 image-input models never receive media.

## Goal
A multimodal message builder that attaches image/audio/video/file parts to the request, gated by the
selected model's input_modalities (core/model_catalog.py).

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an agent with image inputs + an image-capable model, media parts are attached; text-only models never get them.
- A capability/error path exists when a model lacks the needed modality.

## Verification / test plan
- Unit: build a message with an image part against a vision model vs a text-only model.

dashboard_impact.reason: Backend capability; consumed via API, no UI change.
